cipher.summary: Repaired PR #62 by preserving `npm run rewind -- --seam ImageGenerationSeam` through a registry compatibility alias while keeping the provider seam type named `XaiImageProviderSeam`, retaining the narrow image-provider config seam, and expanding provider adapter coverage for HTTP and empty-response failures.
cipher.risks: `ImageGenerationSeam` and `XaiImageProviderSeam` now point at the same self-contained provider seam files; future seam inventory edits must preserve the compatibility alias or update every workflow document that calls the older seam name.
